name: team_planning_history
description: List the history of a scenario of a Team Planning plan the caller is in, oldest first, 100 entries a page, with next_page true when another follows: every change it set, pin and clear it made, every undo and redo of one, and every note written on one, with who did it and when. action is set, pin, clear, undo, redo, note, rebase, move, dates, archive or restore; an undo or redo names the entry it reverses in reverses_event_id, and a note names the change it notes in noted_event_id, with no note when it cleared it. The baseline's history also lists each update to today as action rebase, whose end_state holds base_on, previous_base_on and the conflicts it carried forward, and each time the plan was archived or restored as action archive or restore. A set or pin that settled a conflict an update carried forward has settles: { since, choice }, choice plan or reality, so keeping the plan reads apart from an ordinary edit. A move is an entry of the step a change moved to, whose end_state holds from_scenario_id and direction, and the entries of that change move with it. A dates entry is a step's new period, whose end_state holds starts_on, ends_on, previous_ends_on and, unless written before a first step could start later, previous_starts_on. A null ends_on or previous_ends_on means no end date. A step after one with no end date closes it, a dates entry of the closed step whose end_state holds only ends_on and a null previous_ends_on. An entry that stands undone says who undid it. A change, pin or note entry shows its note as note: { value }, or { removed: true } once the plan is deleted. Any other value that can be erased is never shown here: sealed_fields names any such field. A forgotten person reads as "Former member". Refused, as an unknown plan, unless the caller is a member.
